service.name: cli-health
service.description: Cross-scenario CLI manifest validation and AI command discovery

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o cli-health-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

search-hub.description: Federated search router. cli-health self-registers its `cli-health.commands` provider (descriptor + tuning + tests) from `.vrooli/search.json` at boot so search-hub can route to it and run quality sweeps. Registration is an idempotent upsert.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: If search-hub is down at boot, self-registration retries briefly then gives up; cli-health serves command search normally and re-registers on its next boot.

qdrant.description: Vector database for cross-scenario CLI command semantic search (collection: cli-health-commands).
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Semantic search falls back to BM25-style text matching; reindex is deferred.

ollama.description: Local embedding model (nomic-embed-text) for command index generation.
ollama.degraded_behavior: Embedding generation is unavailable; text-mode search still works.

reranker.description: Cross-encoder reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 via TEI) that reorders the dense command-search shortlist; validated 2026-06-04 to collapse gibberish leakage from 0.583 to 0.000 at sub-second latency.
reranker.degraded_behavior: Reranking falls back to raw dense (cosine) order; search still returns results, only the final ordering is less precise. The local-LLM fallback leg is best-effort only — qwen3:1.7b cannot discriminate (all-zero scores) and qwen3:4b is too slow (~38s/query) to serve, so the cross-encoder resource is effectively required for the rerank quality win.
